# PERRYmix - Perry Machinery Czech Republic, s.r.o.

> Czech manufacturer of new vertical homogenizers (HV-Series, conical screw mixers) for powder and bulk blends. Own production in Hradec Kralove since 1997 for food, pharmaceutical, chemical and feed manufacturers. Made-to-order machines, local service, quote within 48 hours.

## What we deliver

- **HV-Series vertical homogenizer** (conical screw mixer, 50-3,000 L, 10 model sizes HV50-HV3000) - flagship product, available now
- Material: AISI 304 stainless steel standard; product-contact parts in AISI 316L on request
- Options: ATEX drive and gearbox, pneumatic discharge valve, quick-removal screw, tilting locking cover
- Additional machines from our own production (Z-type kneaders, dissolvers, bead/basket/colloid mills) - on individual specification and technical consultation

## Who we serve

- Food manufacturers (puddings, soups, instant drinks, tea and spice blends; food-grade build)
- Pharmaceutical manufacturers (blends for medicines and food supplements; AISI 316L on request)
- Chemical producers (powder paints, pigments, chemical blends; ATEX drive for explosive atmospheres)
- Feed and agrochemistry (feed blends and agricultural premixes)

## Why PERRYmix

- **Own production in the Czech Republic** - machines made to order, from specification to handover
- **Local service base in Hradec Kralove** - original spare parts as the manufacturer, long-term availability
- **Custom engineering** - design adjustments and material grade to the customer's requirements
- **Self-discharging conical screw design** - high degree of homogenization, low power consumption, short mixing time, gentle product mixing
- **Quote within 48 hours** - binding price, technical proposal, delivery time and service terms

## Mixing principle

The HV homogenizer is a conical screw mixer. An orbiting arm carries a rotating mixing screw that draws material from the bottom of the conical vessel upwards while moving along the inner conical wall; the product then slides under gravity back to the bottom. This produces fast, gentle and uniform homogenization with a self-emptying effect.

## Process

1. **Enquiry** - send basic parameters (volume, type of blend, application). Response within 24 hours.
2. **Technical consultation** - online or on-site, 3-5 days to refine specification, material grade, ATEX drive and scope of custom adjustments.
3. **Proposal + price within 48 hours** - binding quote, technical proposal, delivery time and service terms.
4. **Manufacturing and handover** - production in the Czech Republic, inspection, transport and commissioning, operator training and documentation handover.
